result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off — both the image and the restaurant name are truncated at the right edge of the screen, with no visual indicator (like a partial peek or shadow) suggesting it is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible partial card peek with a fade/shadow overlay on the right edge to clearly communicate horizontal scrollability to the user.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen without any clear visual affordance indicating more content is available below.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the partially visible card has enough of its content shown to imply scrollability, or add a subtle gradient overlay at the bottom to signal more content below.
